text: 国家开发银行日前在上海清算所成功簿记发行50亿元3年期绿色金融债券，发行利率1.27%。据介绍，这是国开行首次采用线上簿记建档方式发行绿色金融债券，有效提升了发行效率和透明度。本次发行是国开行优化债券发行定价机制、缩小一二级市场价差的新尝试，也是以市场化方式赋能绿色低碳融资的新探索。本次发行的债券所募集资金将主要用于基础设施绿色升级、节能降碳产业、能源绿色低碳转型、生态保护修复和利用等重点领域。（新华社）
text_en: The China Development Bank (CDB) recently completed bookbuilding issuance of 5 billion yuan in 3-year green financial bonds at the Shanghai Clearing House, with an issuance rate of 1.27%. This marks CDB's first green financial bond issuance using online bookbuilding and filing, effectively improving issuance efficiency and transparency. The issuance represents a new attempt by CDB to optimize bond issuance pricing mechanisms and narrow primary-secondary market spreads, as well as a new exploration of empowering green and low-carbon financing through market-based methods. Proceeds from the bonds will mainly fund key areas including green infrastructure upgrades, energy conservation and carbon reduction industries, green and low-carbon energy transition, and ecological protection and restoration. (Xinhua)
